citation: Balldin UI, Sporrong A. Vibration and decompression gas bubbles. The Physiologist. 1980;23(6 Suppl):S147–S148.
locator: Methods and Figure 1, printed p. S147 (PDF p. 150) and Table 1 and Figure 2, printed p. S148 (PDF p. 151)
note: Ten male volunteers contributed paired Doppler signal durations within alternating 15-minute vibration and non-vibration periods. Only the 15-Hz series has a participant table. The 25-Hz series has no recoverable enrollment or outcome table. The source does not report a clinical DCS numerator or standardized delayed follow-up. The methods report prophylactic oxygen at 200 kPa for 30 minutes. Figure 1 labels the same 30-minute stage as 220 kPa. The actual administered pressure remains unresolved.
